name: Barbarian audit: Rapid Recovery spell modifier reaches its target spells (#2550)
contract: Audit report #2550 asked for a script for a passive whose effects are native spell-mod auras (107 flat, 108 percent). The effect BasePoints and EffectSpellClassMask in Spell.dbc name the spell-mod operation, amount and affected Barbarian spells; Player::ApplySpellMod, which the spell_modifier metric calls, must deliver base+flat or base*(100+pct)/100. Expected values are computed from the DBC amount, not from the implementation. This scenario covers the effect with a resolvable EffectSpellClassMask (aura-108 percent modifier, op 19 ACTIVATION_TIME, targeting Onslaught). The spell's other aura-107 flat modifier (op 1 DURATION, amount 5000) carries an empty SpellClassMask and selects no family-18 spell, so it is out of scope here, matching the #1217-style carve-out for a second effect handled elsewhere.
